title: Final: Codebase cleanup and consistency improvements
body:
- Removed unused and dead code
- Added structured logging and ensured internal errors are logged instead of leaking to the client
- Improved error handling by:
  - Consolidating common errors into shared variables/constants
  - Replacing one-off error definitions with reusable ones
- Fixed and updated tests to align with the current behavior
- Minor refactors for readability and consistency across the codebase
